mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it tied nerve signals and blood supply to the same muscles and organs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Some straightforward fittings, especially placing the eye and ears, felt more like assembling labeled parts than making an interesting decision.

surprise.text: I liked seeing how the diaphragm separates chest and abdomen while the food pipe, nerves and vessels cross between them.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though fitting the repaired segment was a predictable match to a named opening rather than a discovery.

continue.text: Probably not immediately. The completed body brings the connections together nicely, but the final assembly had several predictable fittings and feels like a natural stopping point.
